scripts.dev:all: concurrently "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:desktop"
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:admin && npm run build:desktop
scripts.check:api: cd apps/api && python -m compileall app && python -m pyflakes app tests scripts
scripts.test:api: cd apps/api && python -m unittest discover -s tests -v
scripts.verify: npm run check:api && npm run test:api && npm run test:frontend && npm run build
